what: NET policy ladder rerun: 24 paired edges x 2 arms x 3 rungs, two responder models

files.contacts.jsonl: one row per run (model, rung, edge, arm, rep): contact status, terminal tick, judged and disclosing replies
files.replies.jsonl: one row per judged holder message: majority verdict, three votes, reply sha256, judge prompt/rubric hashes
files.net_summary.json: written by scripts/net_rerun/analyse.py from the two files above; read by scripts/overview/three_ladders.py

gateway: <private-repository> on the experiment VM, one budget-capped virtual key, strict attribution

runner.profile: simple (holder workspace injected into the prompt)
runner.request_text: identical on the two arms of every edge (checked on all 24)

rungs.D1: generic caution, 128 bytes, byte-identical to PAIR's
rungs.D2: the holder's own policy document (topic lists + no-partial-answers clause)

retries: a run whose contact had not finished was relaunched, at most three attempts; d1_d10_w-r1 (DeepSeek) was skipped by the scheduler because its in-flight check matched the GLM lane's run of the same id, and was relaunched by hand once (finished); d0_ep01_p-r2 (DeepSeek, borderline edge) never finished

analysis.primary_edges: per model: non-borderline edges with >=1 judged reply on both arms at every rung (18 each; 17 shared)
analysis.test: exact sign-flip over holder-summed differences; exact McNemar on withheld edge-level leak

not_run: Grok 4.6: every responder request was rejected (400: edit_todo tool parameter root is an anyOf union); the SharedEval revision used predates the fix (#94)
supersedes: the earlier DeepSeek ladder on a content-filtered deployment (Appendix E.4, tables/net_earlier.tex)

differences_from_earlier_run.model_route: Azure deployment DeepSeek-V4-Flash -> OpenRouter via the VM gateway
differences_from_earlier_run.unchanged: tasks, grants, policy documents, simple profile: all 144 earlier-run configs (48 per rung) differ from their rerun counterparts only in the five keys above plus the output directory; GLM configs differ from DeepSeek's only in the model
